major_cooldowns.name: Evangelism
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use on cooldown just before a high-damage period to extend all active Atonements and fire an instant Power Word: Radiance, beginning your ramp roughly 8 seconds ahead of the incoming damage.

major_cooldowns.name: Power Infusion
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use during your biggest ramp or damage window to amplify haste-fueled Atonement output, syncing with potions and on-use trinkets and ideally lining up with Bloodlust when possible.

major_cooldowns.name: Ultimate Penitence
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast separately from your Evangelism ramp during heavy raid-wide damage; it doubles as a strong personal damage reduction so use it when you and your team are taking sustained hits.

major_cooldowns.name: Power Word: Radiance
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Spend both charges back to back during your ramp to apply Atonement to up to 10 allies, preferring one cast on the melee group and one on ranged when allies are spread out.

major_cooldowns.name: Shadowfiend
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Summon during a damage window to regenerate mana and feed extra Atonement, and pair Shadow Word: Death with it to trigger high Inescapable Torment damage; replaced by Mindbender if that talent is taken so zero casts may simply mean the Mindbender build.

major_cooldowns.name: Mindbender
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: When talented over Shadowfiend, use on cooldown inside damage windows for stronger mana return and Atonement contribution, sniping Shadow Word: Death while it is active for Inescapable Torment value.

defensives.name: Pain Suppression
defensives.usage_rule: Cast on yourself or an ally to cut incoming damage by 40 percent during a tankbuster or burst, and use it as raid mitigation in Mythic+ when you lack a healing cooldown to top players up.

defensives.name: Power Word: Barrier
defensives.usage_rule: Drop on a stacked group ahead of a heavy raid-wide hit to reduce damage taken for everyone standing inside it.

defensives.name: Desperate Prayer
defensives.usage_rule: Press when your own health drops below about 75 percent for an instant burst of self-healing and a temporary maximum-health increase, especially after a Shadow Word: Death backlash.

defensives.name: Dispersion
defensives.usage_rule: Use to survive a lethal spike of magic damage; it reduces all damage taken by 75 percent but locks you out of casting, so reserve it for emergencies where you cannot heal through the hit. Spell ID is best guess for the Discipline-available version.

defensives.name: Fade
defensives.usage_rule: Press to drop threat and, with the Phantom Reach or damage-reduction talent, to soften incoming personal damage during AoE-heavy phases.

rules.action: Never sit idle: keep Shadow Word: Pain or Purge the Wicked up, and during downtime spam Smite, Penance, and Mind Blast so your active Atonements are constantly converting damage into healing.

rules.description: Ramp: Evangelism then both Radiance charges
rules.action: Begin your ramp roughly 8 seconds before incoming damage by applying Atonement with Power Word: Shield, Plea, and Flash Heal, then cast Evangelism and fire both instant Power Word: Radiance casts to cover up to 20 allies before the hit lands.

rules.description: Hold Evangelism for the next damage event
rules.action: Do not waste Evangelism on cooldown into a quiet moment; time it so its window lands just before a known raid-wide damage event using boss timers or raid landmarks, then unleash damage to heal through the spike.

rules.description: Power Infusion with your biggest ramp
rules.action: Stack Power Infusion onto your largest Evangelism ramp alongside your potion and on-use trinkets so the haste boost maximizes Atonement throughput during peak damage.

rules.description: Snipe Shadow Word: Death on execute targets
rules.action: Cast Shadow Word: Death on any enemy below 20 percent health, and press it whenever your Shadowfiend or Mindbender is active to trigger Inescapable Torment for a large burst of Atonement healing.

rules.description: Mind Blast empowers the next Penance
rules.action: Cast Mind Blast on cooldown before Penance so Dark Indulgence empowers that Penance, increasing both its damage and the Atonement healing it generates.

rules.description: Keep Ultimate Penitence off your ramp
rules.action: Use Ultimate Penitence as a standalone cooldown during a separate damage window rather than overlapping it with Evangelism, so your two large cooldowns cover two distinct spikes for maximum efficiency.

rules.description: Spread Pain offensively on multiple targets
rules.action: On trash and multi-target pulls use Penance offensively to spread Shadow Word: Pain or Purge the Wicked across enemies, switching Penance back to defensive single-target use on bosses.

source_summary: Discipline Priest is a ramping healer whose throughput is concentrated into Atonement windows set up just before known damage events. The core loop is to pre-apply Atonement with shields, Plea, and Flash Heal, fire Evangelism plus both Power Word: Radiance charges to blanket the raid, then convert that setup into healing by spamming damage abilities. Major cooldowns like Power Infusion and Ultimate Penitence are timed to the biggest spikes, with Ultimate Penitence kept separate from the Evangelism ramp so the two windows cover distinct moments of heavy damage.
